messages:
sara-oncall: :rotating_light: p99 spike for /v1/generate/text observed since ~09:12 UTC. p99 ~1.8s (baseline ~600ms). Customer tickets + Pager. Initial triage: traces show increased compute time on model v3.2 and higher avg seq lengths.

sara-oncall: Repro steps I used:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood/v3.2","prompt":"<~600 token prompt>","max_tokens":1024}'
```
Observed single-request duration: 1.6s server-side.

alex-support: Acknowledged. I'm pulling ticket IDs and affected orgs (org-122, org-821). DMing owners. Will surface to CS and offer temporary credits if needed :+1:

matt-sre: I'm looking at infra. Early check: kernel CPU fine, but model inference queues show long tail. Asking observability for p95/p99 by model and region. @latency-monitor-bot can you dump the last 1h p99 by model?

latency-monitor-bot: p99 (1h window): redwood/v3.2 us-east=1.77s, eu-west=1.82s, redwood/v3.1=0.61s

julia-pm: We started v3.2 rollout at 09:05 (gray). Possible bad kernel selection on some hosts. We should consider immediate rollback or routing to v3.1 for impacted tenants.

sara-oncall: Short mitigations proposed (1) enable circuit-breaker for /v1/generate (2) route fallback to redwood/v3.1 for prod tier (3) reduce route max_concurrency to 8 (4) tighten per-key QPS to 5 for affected orgs (5) turn on prefix KV caching for common prompts. Which can we do quickly?

matt-sre: I can apply circuit-breaker + reduce concurrency and add a routing rule to prefer v3.1 for prod-tiers. Suggest adding a gradual rollback flag too. Commands:
```json
POST /admin/routes/update
{"route":"/v1/generate","circuit_breaker":{"p99_ms":1200,"consecutive_failures":5},"concurrency":8,"fallback_model":"redwood/v3.1"}
```
I'll run that now.

deploy-bot: Started job deploy/route-config/rollback-2478901234. Status: in_progress

alex-support: Noted — I'll notify top 5 customers and ask for repro payloads. Also collecting example traces.

sara-oncall: Also a quick temporary throttle on new sessions might help. For affected orgs set per-org qps=5 and burst=10.

matt-sre: Changes applied to edge routing and circuit-breaker enabled. Observability shows initial p99 drop in us-east to 870ms within 90s.

latency-monitor-bot: p99 (latest): redwood/v3.2 us-east=880ms, eu-west=910ms, redwood/v3.1=610ms

julia-pm: Good. We'll pause the v3.2 rollout until root cause clear. Tagging model-onboarding team.

sara-oncall: Follow-ups: - run regression tests on v3.2 but with kernel constraints - create quick playbook entry under runbooks/latency/ (I'll PR) - set up automated routing fallback when p99 > 1.2s for 5m

matt-sre: Notes for RCA: possible kernel selection mismatch + longer avg seq lengths exposing non-linear perf. Next steps: repro on canary hosts, collect perf counters, compare kernel ops between hosts.

alex-support: I'll send affected payload samples & customer timelines to the RCA thread. Offering 30% credit for impacted windows.

sara-oncall: Closing loop: after mitigations p99 stabilized ~650-900ms across regions. Keeping circuit-breaker in place and v3.2 rollout paused. Will update incident note and link to runbook once PR in. Thanks all :heart:
